description: Type text into an input or textarea with realistic human keystroke intervals. Supports inline post-type waitMs/waitForSelector/waitForText and includeSnapshot.

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

includeSnapshot.description: Capture and return an interactive page snapshot after typing (default: false)

selector.description: CSS selector of input (optional; defaults to focused active element or cursor position)

sleepMs.description: Alias for waitMs: milliseconds to sleep after typing

waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector or @ref to wait for after typing

waitForText.description: Optional text to wait for on the page after typing

waitMs.description: Optional milliseconds to wait/sleep after typing
